value.name: Miles plays weekly chess with Kenneth
value.description: Miles meets his college friend Dr. Kenneth Beck for their regular chess game.
evidence: Miles is at his weekly chess game with his college friend, DR. KENNETH BECK, a disaffected plastic surgeon.

value.name: Miles dismisses a client as worthless
value.description: Miles says the woman involved in his case got nothing from the settlement, implying the client has no leverage left.
evidence: MILES She got absolutely nothing. Zero. Zip.

value.name: Kenneth expects post-settlement cosmetic visits
value.description: Kenneth asks whether he will see Miles's client, noting that clients usually come to him after settlements.
evidence: KENNETH So. I won't be seeing her? Your clients usually visit me after the settlement.

value.name: Miles says client does not need surgery
value.description: Miles explains that this client will not come to Kenneth because her HMO does not cover plastic surgery and she does not need it anyway.
evidence: MILES Not this one. Not unless her HMO covers plastic surgery, which, incidentally, she does not need.

value.name: Kenneth claims everyone needs plastic surgery
value.description: Kenneth responds with his cynical belief that everyone needs plastic surgery, including Miles.
evidence: KENNETH Everyone needs plastic surgery. You need it.

value.name: Kenneth offers Miles Botox
value.description: Kenneth asks Miles if he wants Botox, shifting the conversation to cosmetic treatment.

value.name: Kenneth explains Botox treatment
value.description: Kenneth describes Botox as botulism injected into the forehead to paralyze eyebrows and remove frown lines.
evidence: KENNETH It's a form of botulism. I just inject it into your forehead, and it paralyzes your eyebrows so you can't raise them...

value.name: Kenneth notices Miles's new watch
value.description: Kenneth spots Miles's watch and comments on it, prompting Miles to identify it as a dual-time-zone LeCoultre Revers.
evidence: MILES It's a LeCoultre Revers. You can flip the face, and set it for two time zones.
